instruction: Please enable the setting to show full URLs in Chrome's address bar instead of just the domain.

metadata.explanation: Task requires agent to enable showing full URLs in address bar. The getter reads Chrome Preferences to verify omnibox.show_full_urls is true.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter correctly targets the right Chrome preference: omnibox.prevent_url_elisions
Logic correctly interprets prevent_url_elisions=True as showing full URLs (preventing elisions)
Postconfig appropriately restarts Chrome to ensure preferences are persisted to disk
Metric (exact_match) is suitable for verifying a boolean setting
Expected value 'true' matches the getter's return format
Complete coverage: the single requirement (enable full URLs) is fully verified
Edge cases handled: getter has try-except to handle missing files or parse errors
Runtime feasibility confirmed: postconfig ensures state is accessible with proper timing
